reason: Replaced by exact per-candidate/draft-article outcome accounting hard gates (batch-4 item 1). The old metric (105) was a naive segment-count-minus-draft-count subtraction that could not distinguish a real loss from expected consumption (a cross-page carry swallowing the next candidate). build_page_ledger.py now aggregates a per-candidate/per-draft-article outcome ledger instead, hard-gated at exactly 0 on every build (not baseline-tracked, since it must always be 0 by construction).
